name: check-failure-diagnosis
hypothesis: Models run checks iteratively but don't actually interpret failures to diagnose root causes. Making failure diagnosis explicit—examine diff output or error messages, identify what's wrong, fix specifically—converts failed checks into actionable debugging signals instead of binary fail-retry loops.
prediction: Fixes output-mismatch failures on bugfix-statemachine, feature-topwords, refactor-behavior-preserving, wiring-stats by forcing models to understand WHY checks fail before iterating. These tasks fail despite running checks; the model likely can't parse diff output or error messages to understand what's broken. Expect 36-37/42.
